name: Moonflower~Spirit of Santana

evidence.note: Oct 3, 8 PM at The Showplace, Bellmore: billed as a concert experience with Latin percussion and guitarist Nick Sassano.
Press kit: playing the NY metro area since 2021; says the show keeps audiences on their feet.
News story on an outdoor park concert in Syosset.

dancing.notes: A concert-style tribute in a small theater. The band says it keeps audiences on their feet, and Santana's Latin rhythms invite some dancing, but it is mainly a show.

description: A New York-area Santana tribute band led by guitarist Nick Sassano, with Latin percussion and Santana's guitar-driven Latin rock hits.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Other Santana tributes named Moonflower exist (Tampa, FL and Las Vegas). This is the NY metro band led by Nick Sassano, as named on the Bellmore listing. No salsa evidence.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current website, genres and description are still correct. No Facebook or Instagram page for the band could be confirmed (search shows only personal profiles named Nick Sassano). Booking is through the contact form on Nick Sassano's site (no public email or phone). Several concert photos on the site carry a photographer's watermark in the corner and were skipped. The Bellmore Movies event page from Oct 3, 2026 is gone (404), so the show has passed; no newer dates were listed on the site's gig page.
